doc.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023

title: Upcoming projects: new trio album and East Coast Meeting
summary: He plans the next trio album with Ameen Saleem and a new group, East Coast Meeting, with Dennis Collins and Bill Heller.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Thank you for that. What’s up next for you?

We’re going to start on another, the next trio album. I’ve got four and a half or five things kind of ready, and we’re going to rehearse next week. And I’ve got kind of a time crunch because the bass player Ameen Saleem now lives in Rome so he’s only in New York for — I think he leaves at the end of February. And the holidays and all that stuff kind of — everybody was busy with family stuff so next week we’re going to start rehearsing these new tunes of mine and try to get a feel for them and then maybe go into the studio beginning of February and start recording this stuff. It always takes longer than you think you know and the last album we just did two days in the studio but then the post- production mixing and oh you know publishing clearances and all that stuff, it always takes longer than you think. And I mentioned this other group I have, East Coast Meeting, with a great singer, Dennis Collins, and a keyboard player, Bill Heller. We have met a couple of times and have started writing stuff together, three-way compositions, and he’s a great singer. And Bill is a great keyboard player and I think it’s going to be © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-

good. We’re talking like going into the studio maybe not February, maybe March, and start putting these things down. And there’s live gigs with that group and with a chamber ensemble, a couple of other things going on.
